scenarios.title: Check in at a hotel
goals: Ask which floor breakfast is on

ai.zh: 你好！欢迎来到我们宾馆。你想住几天？
ai.en: Hello! Welcome to our hotel. How many days would you like to stay?

ai.zh: 好的。请把你的护照给我。
ai.en: Okay. Please give me your passport.

ai.zh: 谢谢。你的房间在八层，坐电梯就可以上去。
ai.en: Thank you. Your room is on the eighth floor; you can go up by the elevator.

ai.zh: 在一层，早上六点半开始。
ai.en: On the first floor. It starts at half past six in the morning.

ai.zh: 不客气！有问题可以找我。
ai.en: You are welcome! You can come to me if you have any problem.

you.en: I would like to stay three days.
Okay, here you are.
Okay, which floor is breakfast on?
Okay, thank you.

ai.zh: 你好，你哪里不舒服？
ai.en: Hello, where do you feel unwell?

ai.zh: 从什么时候开始的？
ai.en: Since when?

ai.zh: 你可能感冒了。你要多喝水，多休息。
ai.en: You may have a cold. You need to drink more water and rest more.

ai.zh: 要，这个药一天吃三次，吃完饭再吃。
ai.en: Yes. Take this medicine three times a day, after you finish eating.

ai.zh: 不客气。如果明天还发烧，你再来。
ai.en: You are welcome. If you still have a fever tomorrow, come again.

you.en: I have a headache and a bit of a fever.
Since yesterday evening.
Do I need to take medicine?
Okay, thank you, doctor.

scenarios.title: Plan the weekend
goals: Say you have no plan yet

ai.zh: 这个周末你有什么打算？
ai.en: What are your plans for this weekend?

ai.zh: 天气很好，我们一起去爬山吧。
ai.en: The weather is nice; let us go climbing together.

ai.zh: 早上七点吧。我们在地铁站见面。
ai.en: Seven in the morning. We meet at the subway station.

ai.zh: 可以。那你带点吃的和喝的，好吗？
ai.en: Okay. Then will you bring something to eat and drink?

ai.zh: 太好了，星期天见！
ai.en: Great, see you on Sunday!

you.en: I have no plan yet. What about you?
Sure! What time do we set out?
That is too early; is eight okay?
Okay, I will bring bread and water.

ai.zh: 我听说你要搬家，是真的吗？
ai.en: I heard you will move. Is it true?

ai.zh: 新家在哪儿？附近方便吗？
ai.en: Where is the new home? Is it handy around there?

ai.zh: 太好了！你什么时候搬？
ai.en: Great! When are you moving?

ai.zh: 当然可以！我需要带东西吗？
ai.en: Of course you can! Do I need to bring anything?

ai.zh: 好的，到时候见！
ai.en: Okay, see you then!

you.zh: 是的，我下个月搬到新小区。
you.en: Yes, next month I am moving to a new neighbourhood.

you.zh: 很方便，附近有地铁站和银行。
you.en: Very handy; there is a subway station and a bank nearby.

you.zh: 下个月五号，你可以来帮助我吗？
you.en: On the fifth of next month. Can you come and help me?
No need, thank you. Just come.

scenarios.title: Take the high-speed train
goals: Show your ticket and ask where to check it

ai.zh: 你好！需要帮助吗？
ai.en: Hello! Do you need help?

ai.zh: 十点二十。可是今天晚点了，要等半个小时。
ai.en: Twenty past ten. But today it is late, so you have to wait half an hour.

ai.zh: 可以。你先把票给我看看。
ai.en: Yes, you can. First show me your ticket.

ai.zh: 在那边，然后坐电梯上去。
ai.en: Over there, and then go up by the elevator.

ai.zh: 不客气，再见！
ai.en: You are welcome, goodbye!

you.en: Excuse me, what time does the high-speed train leave?

you.zh: 好的，我的行李可以带上去吗？
you.en: Okay. Can I take my luggage up with me?

you.zh: 好的，给你。我在哪儿检票？
you.en: Okay, here you are. Where do I have my ticket checked?
Thank you.

scenarios.title: Talk about school
goals: Say your result was not good
Say you will ask the teacher

ai.zh: 这次考试你的成绩怎么样？
ai.en: How is your result in this exam?

ai.zh: 没关系。你每天都做作业吗？
ai.en: Never mind. Do you do your homework every day?

ai.zh: 那你要每天复习一点儿，不要太着急。
ai.en: Then you should review a little every day and not worry too much.

ai.zh: 多练习，也可以问老师。
ai.en: Practise more, and you can ask the teacher too.

ai.zh: 很好，我相信你一定可以提高！
ai.en: Good. I am sure you can improve!

you.en: Not so good; my maths is poor.

you.zh: 做，可是我常常忘记复习。
you.en: I do, but I often forget to review.

you.zh: 好的，我会努力的。你有什么好办法？
you.en: Okay, I will work hard. What good ideas do you have?
Okay, I will go and ask the teacher tomorrow.

scenarios.title: Change a shirt
goals: Say you want to change it
Say it is a bit small

ai.zh: 你好！你需要帮助吗？
ai.en: Hello! Do you need help?

ai.zh: 好的。这件有问题吗？
ai.en: Okay. Is there a problem with this one?

ai.zh: 那你要大一点儿的吗？
ai.en: Then do you want a bigger one?

ai.zh: 有。你可以试一下。
ai.en: Yes. You can try it on.

ai.zh: 好的，谢谢你！
ai.en: Okay, thank you!

you.en: I would like to change this shirt.
The size is not right; it is a bit small.
Yes. Do you have a blue one?

you.zh: 好的，这件很合适，我买这件。
you.en: Okay, this one fits well. I will buy this one.

scenarios.title: Call a friend abroad
goals: Agree to talk at the weekend

ai.zh: 好久不见！你在国外生活得怎么样？
ai.en: Long time no see! How is your life abroad?

ai.zh: 你习惯那里的天气了吗？
ai.en: Have you got used to the weather there?

ai.zh: 你要注意身体，多穿一点儿。
ai.en: Take care of yourself and wear a bit more.

ai.zh: 我很忙，可是很开心。我们周末再聊天儿吧。
ai.en: I am busy but happy. Let us chat again at the weekend.

ai.zh: 好，再见！
ai.en: Okay, goodbye!

you.zh: 很好，可是我有点儿想家。
you.en: Very well, but I miss home a bit.

you.zh: 还没有，那里的冬天很冷。
you.en: Not yet; the winter there is very cold.
Okay. How have you been lately?
Sure, see you at the weekend!

phrases.zh: 我没听清楚，请再说一遍。
phrases.en: I did not hear it clearly; please say it once more.

phrases.zh: 你可以说得慢一点儿吗？
phrases.en: Can you speak a little slower?

phrases.zh: 我不太明白，你可以再讲一遍吗？
phrases.en: I do not quite understand; can you explain it again?
I want to look this word up.
